Question
========
What applies to a reproducible experiment?


Answerlist
----------
* Same team
* Same testbed
* Exact same results
* Same software

Solution
========
Reproducibility means that somebody else, who was not part of the original team, can obtain a consistent result using the same experimental setup and the same software. It does not mean bit-identical numbers.

Answerlist
----------
* 0. Repeating with the same team is repeatability, not reproducibility.
* 1. The same experimental setup must be available to whoever repeats the experiment.
* 0. Measurements vary; consistent results within the reported variability are enough.
* 1. The exact software and its version must be pinned, otherwise the experiment cannot be reproduced.
